effort_defaults.notes: Applied via the Workflow tool's agent() opts.effort -- the Agent dispatch tool exposes no per-dispatch effort param on this client (orchestrator-verified 2026-09-01); a plain Agent dispatch inherits the session's own effortLevel and cannot be tiered per-shape at all. Adopt a shape's tier here only after a frozen-task sweep confirms it per the platform cost-optimization doc -- never assumed from the task_defaults model tier alone. Never change effort mid-conversation: switching effort invalidates the prompt cache for that conversation, which is a larger cost than the effort tier itself is meant to save.

escalation.on_churn: same task failing twice on the cheap tier goes to the capable tier on attempt three; never a third cheap retry
escalation.on_demoted_reasoning: a finding demoted in verification for reasoning quality re-runs one tier up
escalation.de_escalate: work a capable model has stabilized into a repeatable recipe moves down one tier after one calibration comparison

review_ladder: batch reviews (operator 2026-10-09; CLAUDE.md §10): one full review per big unit, fix all findings in parallel, then targeted checks scoped to the whole change since review, until clean (3-strike stop); a check becomes full only on a broad/risky fix or a risk-tier / reviewer-of-record change; the old two-targeted cap and high-tier re-escalation are retired
one reviewer per boundary - substitution never stacks
plan review only for substantial plans

code-review full re-review rounds run warm - continue the round-1 reviewer, full scope, cold dispatch is the fallback, max two consecutive warm rounds per boundary; a risk-tier or reviewer-of-record change breaks the warm chain
